title: 133 · Type, form, space and time showreel
provenance: Independent pure-time Canvas reconstruction of the complete 15-second source: resume card, variable typography and serif extrusion, authored Bauhaus shape layout, geometric mesh extrusion with ball bounces, particle TIME and scanning ring clock, and returning resume. No original images, source video, full-frame sequences or external dependencies loaded. Source audio is attributed comparison-only, not authored.

scenes.name: Resume sheet springs into frame
Claude title and skill rows reveal
Resume card settles
Orange dot flies into portal
Condensed TYPE letters fall in
Variable TYPE expands horizontally
Outlined TYPE copies stack and weight thins
Sans TYPE morphs into cream italic type
Long black letter extrusion grows
Circular 01 motion stamp spins
FORM letters and orange O replace type
Letters fragment into Bauhaus grid
Thirty-two geometric forms oscillate in grid
Flat forms swap shapes and colors
Grid tilts into ground plane
Shapes extrude into colored solids
Red ball bounces across rear blocks
Ball arcs over center blocks
Ball bounces near front, camera shifts
Ball zooms into orange radial portal
Orange-white particle wreath assembles
Particle paths converge into TIME letters
TIME point cloud and clock dial
TIME dissolves into curled particle rings
Concentric orange time rings and scanning spokes
Clock wipes into resume and letters land
Resume settles into original layout
Underline, dot, badges and availability reveal
Resume final hold

editable: Palette, duration, marks, scene metadata in project.json. Typography, flat shape manifests, extruded mesh geometry, ball routes and particle field in composition.js.
